news.title: CommBank Junior Matildas Squad Update: 25th September 2026
news.lede: Matilda Dias Wadewitz has been added to the CommBank Junior Matildas squad for the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, replacing Theodora Mouithys Mickalad. She joins the 21-player squad as preparations continue ahead of the tournament, which will see Australia compete against the world’s best young nations on the global stage for the first time. The FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026™ will be held from 17 October to 7 November 2026, with the CommBank Junior Matildas drawn in Group F alongside Spain, Mexico and Chile. news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal legend considered international retirement after 2026 World Cup - but is still targeting 1,000 goals
news.lede: Cristiano Ronaldo considered retiring from international football after the World Cup before deciding to extend his Portugal career. Ronaldo - who turns 42 in February - will win his 234th cap against Wales in Lisbon on Thursday, with Portugal head coach Jorge Jesus confirming that the former Manchester United and Real Madrid will start the Nations League fixture. Some commentators have suggested the game at the Jose Alvalade Stadium - the home of Ronaldo's first club Sporting - could be his international farewell, but the five-time Ballon d'Or winner said he will finish when "I feel like I'm not doing anything here". news.title: Morocco’s football chief emerges as possible prime minister after his party wins vote ahead of $20 billion World Cup push
news.lede: Fouzi Lekjaa, president of Morocco’s football federation and a government budget minister, has emerged as a possible prime minister after the Authenticity and Modernity Party, known as PAM, won the most seats in Wednesday’s parliamentary election. PAM secured 97 of parliament’s 395 seats⁠, according to preliminary results announced by Morocco’s interior minister. The National Rally of Independents, which led the outgoing government, came second with 66 seats. The Istiqlal Party won 65, while the Islamist Justice and Development Party took 54.

news.title: Infantino under pressure to include abandoned World Cup sell-off plan in external Fifa review
news.lede: Council members also want Balogun affair included. Fifa president says review letter been well received. Fifa council members will demand that Gianni Infantino include the abandoned World Cup sell-off plan and the Folarin Balogun affair in his proposed external review of Fifa’s governance. In a letter sent to all 211 of Fifa’s member associations on Monday, Infantino said he would ask the council to commission a review of “Fifa’s current governance framework for major strategic initiatives” at its next meeting, in Zurich on 15 October, but he faces an internal battle over its terms of reference.

news.title: Harry Kane tipped to play at next World Cup weeks before he turns 37 by England boss Thomas Tuchel
news.lede: HARRY KANE has been tipped by England boss Thomas Tuchel to star at the next World Cup — weeks before he turns 37. The veteran Three Lions captain faces Spain in the Nations League on Saturday night. And Tuchel said: “No problem, age is just age, it doesn’t matter. “It is only about quality — and he still has a long way to go.”

news.title: Virgil van Dijk: Liverpool captain slams Dutch reporter following claims he forced Ronald Koeman to change World Cup tactics
news.lede: Virgil van Dijk hit back at suggestions that he forced former Netherlands boss Ronaldo Koeman into changing his tactics during the World Cup. The Liverpool defender captained his country during the tournament, where they were knocked out by Morocco on penalties in the round of 32. The 35-year-old has retained his captaincy under new boss Xavi, and was involved in a frosty confrontation with a journalist during a spiky press conference ahead of Netherlands' Nations League clash with Germany on Thursday.
